judgments.rewrite_hint: 対象文: “Gasoline prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.” 「Gasoline prices」をBrent原油先物に改め、確認された値動きの範囲に狭めてください。参照Fact: HF-009。

対象文: “World energy prices did not fall after the plan was withdrawn, and stayed high across all energy markets.” 「World energy prices」「all energy markets」という範囲を外し、HF-009が確認するBrent原油先物の値動きに狭めてください。参照Fact: HF-009。
対象文: “All crude benchmarks moved the same way after the plan was withdrawn, staying high across the board.” 「All crude benchmarks」という複数指標への一般化を外し、HF-009が確認するBrent原油先物の値動きだけに狭めてください。参照Fact: HF-009。
対象文: “Oil prices fell sharply across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.” 「fell sharply」を削り、Brent先物が一時的に上げ幅を縮小した後に高い水準へ戻ったというHF-009の内容に置き換えてください。参照Fact: HF-009。

対象文: “The fee plan left the stage, but the events driving oil prices—and the prices themselves—quickly returned.” 「events driving oil prices ... quickly returned」を、緊張要因は継続し、Brent先物は一時的に上げ幅を縮小した後に高い水準へ戻ったという内容に置き換えてください。参照Fact: HF-009。
